name: experience_recall_status
description: Report this repository's experience-recall health in one shot: which adapter is wired (or adapter=none when the capability is disabled), the index identity, record/candidate/exclusion counts, the lifecycle tally (admitted/superseded/expired/deleted), active exclusions, and the freshness verdict — exactly as emitted by the experience-recall.sh bash twin. READ-ONLY: this tool adds NO scoring, NO freshness computation, and NO source validation of its own; it shells out to the twin and returns its stdout/stderr/exit code verbatim. A disabled adapter is a REAL answer, not a failure: the twin exits 0 with an explicit disabled payload, so use this before `search_experience` to tell 'recall is off' apart from 'recall is on and found nothing'. Status never mutates the index; re-indexing (sync) and every other mutating subcommand (admit, delete, lifecycle, export) are deliberately CLI-only and are NOT reachable from MCP.

format.description: Output format. Defaults to json (the machine-readable status payload). Use text for the human-readable rendering.
